name: contract_m6_tables
description: The M6 contract (docs/design/contract-m6.md) holds: the id lists continue with the Bellfounder's and the Beekeeper's eighteen tower forms, the two Builders, tide_race and their two perks, each a wire id where the wire has one; both kits are the design's (towers, strong checks, patching branches, perk, plan); every tower key is one a contract names and the Toll Tower pulses a stun, the Chime Post cracks, the Clay Hive clouds and the Hive Hum hastens; EV_PULSE is 19 and EV_RACE 20; the queue's numbers (15 s to accept, the caretaker offer at 60 s) are protocol.json's; every new id has its display entry and icon path; a model not built yet loads as a stand-in; and the tide_race preset, once the rules track adds it, is two teams on the hollow with a 20-minute cap and a minute a life (contract-m6's 10 s, raised in M8).

steps.msg: the code keeps the M6 contract
